name: Alexander Wurz
features: fair skin, short fair hair, long face, very tall lean build, calm expression
bio: Le Mans winner with Porsche in 1996 and Peugeot in 2009, a Formula One podium finisher, and unmistakable for being far taller than a racing driver has any business being. Retired at the end of the 2015 season and went on to chair the Grand Prix Drivers’ Association.
